title: Bymax country flag metadata
description: The metadata of one country flag: icons/meta/<name>.json, beside icons/flags/<name>.svg.

title.description: The English name of the region, as Intl.DisplayNames gives it.

code.description: The code of the flag in its source, upper case: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or a code of the source for a region.

source.description: Where the drawing was taken from: the file at the pinned version of its repository.

license.description: The license of the drawing, such as MIT.

retrievedAt.description: The day the drawing was retrieved.
